locators.title: Major rivers and urban centers in the Pilbara-Gascoyne region
Rivers and catchments in the Pilbara-Gascoyne region

own_factual_extraction: Both figures show a Wooramel-labelled river corridor westward to the coast south of the Gascoyne system.
A Greenough-labelled river corridor extends southwest from inland country to the Geraldton coastal sector.
The Wooramel and Greenough courses are separately located from Murchison, Gascoyne and other regional rivers; river labels and catchment labels are distinct.
limits: Coarse regional raster maps support representative system/mainstem identity only.
No coordinate-grid registration, exact line fit, tributary inheritance, headwater naming transition or source-reach name crosswalk is established.
The two figures are one publication, not two independent sources.

own_factual_extraction: Table 9 records a Wooramel River surface-water management area; Figure 11 locates that area south of the Gascoyne system on the west coast.
The Mid West chapter identifies Greenough as a west-flowing river; Figure 15 labels its regional management area inland of Geraldton.
limits: The large Wooramel River and Greenough River management-area labels do not name every stream within those polygons.
The report corroborates geography and official English usage, not a reach-by-reach or current formal gazetteer designation.

sources.direct_quote: discharges to the Indian Ocean at Cape Burney
own_factual_extraction: DWER places the headwaters on the Yilgarn Plateau north of Yalgoo and describes a southwest-flowing river through the Waterloo Range.
The outlet is associated with Cape Burney south of Geraldton.
limits: The textual corridor description does not identify the name of every selected HydroRIVERS source reach or establish a surveyed mouth coordinate.
